## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3-vl-8b` | vision | `vision_model` | `Qwen3VL-8B-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | resident |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

The installer seeds this tier's media bindings (`config_seed`):

| `imagegen_cfg` | `1` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #16 (2x homogeneous Blackwell 16GB; the reference box IS the workstation: RTX 5070 Ti 16GB ~896 GB/s + RTX 5060 Ti 16GB ~448 GB/s x8-electrical, PCIe Gen3 X299, quad-channel DDR4-3400, 128GB, no iGPU so the UTILITY card pays the desktop/DWM ~0.5-1.5GB tax). Full design + arithmetic: Drive Local-Offload-Harness/2026-08-02-blackwell-2x16-tier-research.md. TOPOLOGY IS PIN-DON'T-SPLIT: every seat fits one card and is pinned whole (splitting a fits-on-one-card model costs 20-33% tg — sequential per-token pipeline, harmonic-mean arithmetic, verified); the fast card holds the latency primaries + vision, the utility card holds the memory-stack residents + STT + desktop. The STT seat is residency=resident ON PURPOSE: it lives on the OTHER card, so it may run concurrently with any fast-card model — that concurrency is the second card's payoff for this route. DEVICE IDENTITY: pins are PCI_BUS_ID indices matching the reference box (0=5060 Ti, 1=5070 Ti); verify with nvidia-smi after any slot change or BIOS reset (this board wipes settings on AC loss) and substitute GPU UUIDs if enumeration moved — a silent flip inverts every placement. MEASURED verdicts carried from the single-GPU era and still binding: self-built CUDA 12.8 sm_120 build mandatory; no spec-decode except where llama.cpp has the model's MTP graph (Qwen3.5/3.6 yes, DeepSeek-class measured dead here); mmap (never --no-mmap/--mlock) for 70GB+ models + a warm-up request + a wait-for-RAM guard; all-experts-CPU wins for V4-Flash-class MoE until an -ot A/B on THIS Gen3-x8 link proves otherwise; -b/-ub 2048, threads 18; q4_0 KV banned; vision mmproj F16 only. SEAT LIFECYCLE (house rule 2026-08-02): every seat here is the measured INCUMBENT; challengers enter ONLY via documented bake-off in Benchmarks and Optimizations/. SEAT VERDICTS LANDED (2026-08-12..14, tier-matrix catch-up): IMAGE incumbent is now Krea 2 Turbo bf16 (24.5GB, 8-step turbo recipe) — won the blinded 32GB bake-off 2-0-2 over Qwen-Image-2512 (editorial + text-rendering pairs; record in Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-14-nightshift4-notes.md), bound via DisTorch2 ratio pooling (the imagegen_pool_* seed keys; --disable-dynamic-vram stays mandatory on both launch surfaces) in harness 0.59.0. HiDream-O1 leaves this tier's seat but REMAINS the proven binding for every single-16GB tier (24.5GB does not fit one card — do not propagate the krea2 seed downward). VIDEO verdict decided 2026-08-12: LTX-2.5 distilled int8 beat Wan 2.2 + MiniMax-H3 on every axis at once (1920x1088@24fps with joint audio in 247s vs Wan's 720p/16fps/no-audio/1134s); the Wan2.2 videogen seed below stays only until the binding leg executes (Seat Frontier plan Leg 3) — wf-ltx builder + config binding pending. CODER+AGENT seats DECIDED 2026-08-14 (Seat Frontier Leg 1, measured): Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (16.7GB pooled, thinking) WON both — coder vs Qwen3-Coder-30B (v3 decision set 14/16 vs 7/16; actioneval e2e 9/9 vs 7/9; loser's GGUF deleted per the disk rule) and agent vs the 31B-agent seat (custody paired D1 tie 15/15-15/15 at -39% output tokens / -31% wall; actioneval 9/9 vs 8/9; 31B-agent entry kept as rollback).
